verdict.rationale: The alerting docs say notifications route issues "to the correct system or team" but never mention registrable outbound webhooks. The vulnerability agent's Jira/GitHub issue creation and the generic "automated remediation" marketing line are separate features, not alert webhooks. There is no evidence that alert notifications can target an HTTP endpoint that triggers remediation or agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents
